AVX-512 batched SHA-256 with fallback to narrower AVX for small batches.

# Purpose
This file implements the AVX-512 batch path for `SHA-256` hashing. The main function, [`fd_sha256_private_batch_avx512`](<#fd_sha256_private_batch_avx512>), takes up to `FD_SHA256_BATCH_MAX` messages, their sizes, and output hash buffers, then processes the messages in parallel with 512-bit SIMD operations. It first falls back to [`fd_sha256_private_batch_avx`](<#fd_sha256_private_batch_avx>) for small batches, then builds padded tail blocks for each message, runs the `SHA-256` compression rounds with vectorized state and message schedule operations, and finally stores the resulting digests to the output buffers.

The code is part of a private internal implementation, not a public API. It depends on `fd_sha256.h`, `fd_sha256_constants.h`, and SIMD helper headers from `fd_avx512.h` and `fd_avx.h`. The file also uses internal vector transpose, byte-swap, and lane-selection helpers to manage 16-way parallel processing and to handle messages that finish at different times within the same batch.
